correctness.rationale: The full proof directly identifies all faces under disjoint union and graph join, proves path-connectedness of both parent complexes, and applies the standard graph-of-spaces one-cell formula. The union operation is simplicial join and produces multiplicities by the join/smash theorem. The cotree base is a point; induction is valid for every finite nonempty cograph. All degree ranges and the m1*m2=1 boundary are handled. The direct mod-two boundary checker agreed with 240 independent cotrees on 1..10 vertices and the mixed nine-vertex example; the checker is only a finite supplemental test.

value.rationale: For every P4-free graph, the cotree determines the complete integral homotopy type of the natural component-size-two independence complex, with exact graded sphere multiplicities and no torsion. The graph-join operation adds cycles in a structurally nontrivial manner absent from the ordinary independence-complex recursion. The nine-vertex example exhibits homology in degrees one and three, so the theorem is not merely the known equidimensional complete-multipartite classification. It supplies a reusable algorithmic topological invariant for a broad hereditary graph class.
